verdict.rationale: Svelte's core value proposition is compiling declarative, encapsulated components with local state into efficient JS, and community evidence corroborates real-world composition of components into complex apps (stores/context for sharing state, readable compiled output, successful migrations of complex React apps). Missing for 10: no first-party deep-dive citation on component composition patterns/slots or independent benchmarking of encapsulation guarantees beyond general praise.
